description:
Nightwing provides technically advanced full-spectrum cyber, data operations, systems integration and intelligence mission support services to meet our customers’ most demanding challenges. Our capabilities include cyber space operations, cyber defense and resiliency, vulnerability research, ubiquitous technical surveillance, data intelligence, lifecycle mission enablement, and software modernization. Nightwing brings disruptive technologies, agility, and competitive offerings to customers in the intelligence community, defense, civil, and commercial markets.

 Nightwing is seeking experienced Windows Application Developers to support the design, development, testing, and maintenance of Windows-based software applications. The ideal candidates will possess strong expertise in low-level Windows systems development and demonstrate proficiency across multiple programming languages and development tools.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, test, and debug Windows-based applications

 Perform low-level systems development using Windows APIs

 Develop and maintain software using C, C++, and Python

 Utilize Visual Studio IDE and Windows SDK for application development

 Troubleshoot and resolve complex software and system issues

 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to meet project requirements

 Ensure software solutions meet performance, security, and quality standards

 
 Required Qualifications 
 Current TS/SCI with Poly Clearance

 
 Candidates must meet the following minimum requirements:
 Three (3) years of experience developing, testing, and debugging software in each of the following languages:
 C

 C++

 Python

 
 Three (3) years of demonstrated, in-depth experience developing, testing, and debugging software for Windows operating systems 

 Proven experience using:
 Visual Studio IDE

 Windows SDK

 
 Demonstrated in-depth understanding of:
 Windows low-level systems development

 Windows APIs and system internals

 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with multithreaded and performance-critical applications

 Familiarity with Windows kernel concepts, memory management, and process/thread handling

 Experience working in secure or regulated environments

 Strong documentation and communication skills

 
 
 
 
 Please Note: This position is contingent upon contract award.
 
 Salary & Benefits
 
The salary associated with this position ($122,000-$253,000) is commensurate with the selected candidate’s qualifications, years of relevant experience, and demonstrated level of expertise. Compensation will be determined based on these factors to ensure alignment with skills, responsibilities, and market standards. 
Nightwing offers medical, vision and dental insurance coverage in addition to a 401k plan, PTO, Holidays, and additional insurances.
 
 
Nightwing is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.
